name: chocolate magic shell
instructions:
The ice-cream-hardening chocolate shell: chocolate + coconut oil, melted together.

=== RATIO ===

- 100g chocolate chips
- 25-35g coconut oil

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. Ideally mix in a DOUBLE BOILER until melted and combined.
2. Pour over something cold (ice cream) — the coconut oil sets it into a hard shell on contact.
notes:
=== WHY IT WORKS ===

Coconut oil is solid below ~76°F — cutting it into the chocolate gives the mixture a sharp setting point, so it snaps into a shell against anything freezer-cold.

=== NOT A FONDUE YET ===

This is NOT a fondue without some CREAM to stabilize — the chocolate + coconut oil mixture alone doesn't hold as a warm dipping pot. Cream is the missing stabilizer if a fondue direction ever gets tried.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[chocolate-ganache]]: the cream-stabilized cousin — that's the topping that stays soft.
- [[tofu-chocolate-mousse]] / [[chocolate-chip-cookies]]: the chocolate-dessert neighbors.
